strategy_assumptions.hourly_profile: 8,760 deterministic synthetic operating hours bounded by the solved N-0 electrical ceiling.
strategy_assumptions.flexibility: Customer-side managed reduction follows the versioned activation policy.
strategy_assumptions.battery: State-of-charge, reserve, efficiency, power and energy are enforced; dispatch is representative planning, not real-time control.
strategy_assumptions.staging: Stages are representative; reinforcement scope and delivery dates are not modelled.
